purpose: Thread-safe append-only file logger that writes to %APPDATA%\IdleLauncherTray\IdleLauncherTray.log with automatic rotation at ~2MB.
invariants: All public methods swallow their own exceptions — logging never crashes the app
Log rotation is checked every 10 writes; rotated file becomes .log.old, overwriting any previous .old
Directory is created lazily on first write using a double-checked lock
gotchas: Rotation check uses Interlocked on _writeCount but the rotation itself runs inside the _gate lock — the counter and the rotation are not atomic with each other, so rotation may trigger slightly late
Each log line includes pid and managed thread id for diagnosing multi-instance scenarios
